# MindMesh — Error Patterns

Anti-patterns and known mistakes to catch in code review and audits.
The section below the marker is auto-generated by knowledge-bridge; the section above is hand-maintained.

## Hand-Maintained Patterns

### Critical — Security

| Pattern | Why | Instead |
|---|---|---|
| `f"SELECT ... WHERE id = {user_id}"` | SQL injection | Parameterized query via Supabase client |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY` | Exposes privileged key to browser | Only `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` and `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` are safe |
| Stripe webhook without `stripe.Webhook.construct_event()` | Forgeable requests | Always verify signature before processing |
| Processing a Stripe event without checking `stripe_events` table | Duplicate processing | Check idempotency key first, insert after |

### High — Broken Conventions

| Pattern | Why | Instead |
|---|---|---|
| `print(...)` in any backend file | Lost in production, bypasses structlog | `structlog.get_logger().info(...)` |
| `raise Exception(...)` or `raise HTTPException(...)` in services | Not typed, no `code`/`user_message` | Raise a `MindMeshError` subclass |
| `return {"key": "value"}` from a FastAPI route | No schema validation, no docs | Return a Pydantic response model instance |
| `supabase = create_client(url, key)` in a router or service | Bypasses DI, untestable | `db = Depends(get_db)` |
| Inline LLM prompts in Python strings | Untraceable, untemplatable | Jinja2 template in `prompts/templates/` |
| LLM call without `@retry(stop=stop_after_attempt(3), ...)` | Single transient failure breaks job | Wrap with tenacity |
| `npm install` / `npm run` in this repo | TAR_ENTRY_ERROR on Windows | `pnpm install` / `pnpm run` |

### Medium — Frontend

| Pattern | Why | Instead |
|---|---|---|
| `fetch('/api/...')` directly in a component | Bypasses error handling wrapper | `apiFetch<T>()` from `lib/api.ts` |
| `style={{ color: 'red' }}` inline styles | Not scannable, breaks design system | Tailwind utility classes |
| `'use client'` at the top of every component | Disables RSC, increases bundle | Only add when hooks/events/browser APIs needed |
| Type defined inline in component file | Drift between frontend and backend | Define in `types/index.ts`, keep in sync with Pydantic schema |
